items.title: PepsiCo Stock And Other Defensive Value Picks For Higher Rates
items.summary: Fed officials are openly debating whether rates need to climb again, and that raises the stakes for U.S. large caps that rely on stable funding costs and steady consumer demand. When policy makers talk about getting “behind the curve” on inflation, investors who react late risk watching others reposition first.
